correctness.rationale: For every field \(k\), \(t\ge2\), \(e_i\ge2\), every associative symmetric form is \(B_f(a,b)=f(ab)\), uniquely by the unit. On branch \(i\), the nonzero top coefficient \(c_{i,h_i}\) gives invertible anti-triangular Gram block of size \(h_i-1\), while an adjusted unit together with branch-top powers yields a residual rank-two matrix \(\begin{pmatrix}c&v^T\\v&0\end{pmatrix}\) for \(v\ne0\). This proves rank 0/1 for zero-height and rank \(2+\sum_{i\in S}(h_i-1)\) otherwise, independent of characteristic. Multiplying independent height weights \((q-1)q^{h_i-1}\) yields the complete polynomial; \(\operatorname{rank}\le R\) inequalities yield saturated bounded-excess linear subspaces whose index vectors form an antichain and whose dimension is \(t+R-1\). The packaged standalone checker directly builds the multiplication Gram matrices and exhausts all \(f\) in 18 small finite-field configurations including GF(4); this is corroboration and not the arbitrary-field proof.

value.rationale: A natural unbounded class of local fiber-product rings with socle type \(t\ge2\) has no Frobenius multiplication pairing. The full characteristic-free rank classification, generic radical size \(t-1\), equidimensional linear component decomposition at every reduced degeneracy threshold, and an exact q-polynomial counting ALL pairings at EVERY rank refine the classical binary Frobenius obstruction into meaningful intrinsic algebraic and arithmetic invariants. The result is not an arbitrary finite slice, nor merely an ordinary nondegeneracy test.
